scripts.build: pnpm validate-rules && pnpm type-check && next build
scripts.validate-rules: cat package.json | grep -v 'validate-rules' | grep -E 'tailwindcss|tailwind|@tailwindcss|@mui|antd|chakra' && { echo '❌ ERROR: Dependencia prohibida detectada'; exit 1; } || echo '✅ OK: No hay dependencias prohibidas'
